examples.description: Render every codependix example and compare it against the committed output under `output/`, or rewrite it. `check` is what keeps the guides honest: a resolver or scanner change that silently reverses one of the documented behaviors fails here rather than leaving a guide quoting a diagram the tool no longer renders. Unlike `codebase:codependix`, both configurations are safe on a branch — every example is built from subjects this package owns, so nothing here moves when the workspace around it does.
